opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Establish a safe economy with a fast expansion while teching to Warp Gate for early pressure or defense.
supporting_facts: The opening has a high inv_technology (0.829) and inv_upgrade (0.335), with 100% of games observing a first upgrade (Warp Gate Research) and 99.3% having a Cybernetics Core.
The key sequence shows early Gateway, Gas, Cybernetics Core, then a second Gateway and second Gas before Warp Gate Research, indicating a focus on tech and production.
The opening has a low inv_expansion (0.092) relative to other openings, suggesting the expansion is not the primary focus early on.
The distinctive flags show a higher rate of second production (56.6%) and first combat unit (55.2%) compared to baseline, indicating early unit production.
The winrate is 47.6% with 1090 games, suggesting it is a common but slightly below-average opening.
